ski: A system brings snow to the Washington Cascades Sunday with the snow level uncertain, ~3,900 to 4,500 ft, and Tuesday turns drier. Snow coming: Mt Baker gets 4 in at 4,294 ft and the Mount St. Helens backcountry 7 in at 6,936 ft by Thursday, NWAC has no rating posted. Best ski day: Mount St. Helens on Tuesday, good weather window until about 8 PM, then gusts, NWAC has no rating posted.
hike: Snow showers linger in the Washington Cascades through Monday, and Tuesday turns drier. Best hike day: North Cascades Highway on Tuesday, good weather window all day, through 10 PM, NWAC has no rating posted.
